name: Erratic Charge
body:
Erratic Charge (Ex)
Source Villain Codex pg. 176
As part of the full-round action to perform a charge attack against a creature at least 20 feet away, the barbarian can move 5 feet in any direction before making the charge. This movement is not a 5-foot step and provokes attacks of opportunity as normal, and using this option reduces the maximum distance of the charge by 10 feet.
